name: Rev
description: Rev is a transcription and captioning service for turning recorded speech into accurate, usable text. People and organizations use it for professional transcripts, captions, subtitles, legal transcription, AI-generated drafts, and downloadable deliverables.
agentUseSummary: Enter API keys from the customer's own Rev account, then let agents upload source URLs, place and track transcription or caption orders, and retrieve deliverables under Safe or Dangerous policy; production orders are billed to that customer account.

credentialRequirements.name: REV_CLIENT_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Rev client API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the client API key from the customer's API-enabled Rev account.

credentialRequirements.name: REV_USER_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Rev user API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the matching user API key from the same Rev account.

capabilities.label: Track orders
capabilities.description: List and inspect transcription, caption, legal, and AI orders in the connected Rev account.

capabilities.label: Retrieve deliverables
capabilities.description: Inspect and download authorized source files, transcripts, captions, subtitles, and AI drafts.

capabilities.label: Place and manage orders
capabilities.description: Upload source URLs, place paid or sandbox orders, and cancel eligible orders.

capabilities.label: Share and remove data
capabilities.description: Create non-expiring Rev Editor links and remove order attachments or related data.

capabilities.label: Use the complete Rev API
capabilities.description: Use every current documented Human Transcription and Caption API operation authorized by the account.

allowed.label: List orders
allowed.description: List one bounded page of orders.

allowed.label: Read order
allowed.description: Read one order and its current status.

allowed.label: Read attachment details
allowed.description: Read metadata for one source file or deliverable.

allowed.label: Download deliverable
allowed.description: Retrieve one bounded source file, transcript, caption, subtitle, or AI draft.

allowed.label: List workspaces
allowed.description: List the workspaces available to the connected account.

allowed.label: List legal templates
allowed.description: List legal transcription templates available to the connected account.

approvalRequired.label: Add source URL
approvalRequired.description: Register a URL-hosted media source for a new Rev order.

approvalRequired.label: Place order
approvalRequired.description: Place a paid or sandbox transcription, caption, legal, or AI order.

approvalRequired.label: Cancel order
approvalRequired.description: Cancel an eligible order before work begins.

approvalRequired.label: Delete order data
approvalRequired.description: Remove an order's attachments and related data.

approvalRequired.label: Create share link
approvalRequired.description: Create a non-expiring Rev Editor link for a deliverable.

approvalRequired.label: Use full Rev API
approvalRequired.description: Use any current documented operation on Rev's fixed API origin; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded order, workspace, template, attachment, and deliverable reads run directly; uploads, paid or sandbox orders, cancellation, deletion, sharing, and other operations require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected account-authorized Rev API operation runs without Relay per-action approval; ownership, credential secrecy, fixed origin, response bounds, audits, customer billing, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts selected Rev tools and injects the encrypted client and user API keys server-side.
Railway mounts selected Rev tools and injects the encrypted client and user API keys server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer Rev API credentials, API-enabled plan, or signed-in provider session is available for production acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: Enable API access on the customer's Rev account, create client and user API keys, connect them in Relay Console, then verify bounded reads, a sandbox order, Safe denial, approved or Dangerous mutation, redaction, key rotation, and disconnect; place a production order only deliberately because it is billed to that customer.

evidence.supports: Rev documents its customer-account Human Transcription and Caption API, API-key-pair authorization, input upload, order lifecycle, attachments, workspaces, and legal templates.
The official operation index documents paid and sandbox order placement, tracking, cancellation, deletion, attachment retrieval, non-expiring editor sharing, workspaces, and templates.
Rev describes the service as human transcription and captioning charged through the customer's account, with API access dependent on that account's plan.
